verdict.rationale: Postmark documents customizable data retention: activity retention can be set up to 365 days, with a 45-day default. This is a paid add-on ($5/month, Pro plans or higher), so retention control is a first-party capability but is gated. The pack has no documented user-initiated deletion of message or activity data; deleting a server is only an adjacent account-management action. Missing for 10: documented on-demand deletion or purge of messages and recipient data, retention control without the paid add-on and plan gating, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
